run_experiment: run a Stretch robot velocity and acceleration experiment with different motion profiles via CLI
run_robot_motion: run robot manipulator motion to a target pose with specified velocity and acceleration profiles
get_velocities: get joint velocity values from a motion profiles dictionary for a given speed setting
get_accelerations: get joint acceleration values from a motion profiles dictionary for a given speed setting
read_yaml: read and parse a YAML file into a Python dictionary using yaml.safe_load
